en: Hetuduka, Atītārammaṇattika (The Triplet of Past Objects within the Dyad of Causes)
Dependent on a non-root dhamma with a non-past object, a root dhamma with a past object arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
Dependent on a non-root dhamma with a non-future object, a root dhamma with a future object arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is not a root and does not have a present object, there arises a state that is a root and has a present object by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under root [condition] there are three; ... pe ... under non-disappearance [condition] there are three.
